```{r}
source("../R/modeling/00_model_helpers.R")
source("../R/unicode_utils.R")

# knitr formats table captions and column names through the active Windows
# character locale. In a C locale, non-ASCII glyphs can become ASCII
# code-point notation. Decode that representation once, after the complete
# Markdown document is assembled and before Quarto passes it to Pandoc.
knitr::knit_hooks$set(document = function(x) {
  decode_uplus_notation(x)
})

read_step5d <- function(name) {
  read.csv(
    file.path(model_audit_dir, name),
    check.names = FALSE,
    fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
  )
}
figure_5d <- function(name) file.path(model_figure_dir, name)

threshold_samples <- read_step5d("step5d_threshold_samples.csv")
threshold_fit <- read_step5d("step5d_threshold_fit.csv")
threshold_coefficients <- read_step5d("step5d_threshold_coefficients.csv")
threshold_stability <- read_step5d("step5d_threshold_stability.csv")
release_fit <- read_step5d("step5d_release_fit.csv")
release_coefficients <- read_step5d("step5d_release_coefficients.csv")
release_comparison <- read_step5d("step5d_release_comparison.csv")
price_fit <- read_step5d("step5d_price_fit.csv")
price_coefficients <- read_step5d("step5d_price_coefficients.csv")
price_comparison <- read_step5d("step5d_price_comparison.csv")
price_predictions <- read_step5d("step5d_price_predicted_contrasts.csv")
genre_fit <- read_step5d("step5d_genre_fit.csv")
genre_coefficients <- read_step5d("step5d_genre_coefficients.csv")
genre_comparison <- read_step5d("step5d_genre_comparison.csv")
stability <- read_step5d("step5d_core_predictor_stability.csv")
direction <- read_step5d("step5d_direction_matrix.csv")
diagnostics <- read_step5d("step5d_diagnostics.csv")
fit_warnings <- read_step5d("step5d_fit_warnings.csv")

term_labels_zh <- c(
  "(Intercept)" = "截距",
  z_log1p_price = "当前价格（log1p，标准化）",
  z_days_since_release = "上市至评论快照天数（标准化）",
  `platform_segmentWindows + macOS` = "Windows + macOS",
  `platform_segmentWindows + Linux` = "Windows + Linux",
  `platform_segmentWindows + macOS + Linux` = "三平台支持",
  genre_action = "Action", genre_adventure = "Adventure",
  genre_casual = "Casual", genre_indie = "Indie", genre_rpg = "RPG",
  genre_simulation = "Simulation", genre_strategy = "Strategy",
  genre_early_access = "Early Access", genre_sports = "Sports",
  genre_racing = "Racing"
)
spec_labels_zh <- c(
  PRIMARY = "主规格（评论数 ≥ 20）",
  TH_GT0 = "评论数 > 0",
  TH_10 = "评论数 ≥ 10",
  TH_50 = "评论数 ≥ 50",
  RELEASE_MONTH = "发布月份替代规格",
  PRICE_RAW = "原始价格替代规格",
  GENRE_EXPANDED = "扩展 Genre 规格"
)
class_labels_zh <- c(
  ROBUST = "ROBUST（稳健）",
  PARTIAL = "PARTIAL（部分稳健）",
  SENSITIVE = "SENSITIVE（对规格敏感）"
)
term_zh <- function(x) {
  mapped <- unname(term_labels_zh[x])
  ifelse(is.na(mapped), x, mapped)
}
spec_zh <- function(x) {
  mapped <- unname(spec_labels_zh[x])
  ifelse(is.na(mapped), x, mapped)
}
yes_no_zh <- function(x) ifelse(x, "是", "否")

focus_terms <- c(
  "z_log1p_price", "z_days_since_release",
  "platform_segmentWindows + macOS", "platform_segmentWindows + Linux",
  "platform_segmentWindows + macOS + Linux", "genre_indie", "genre_rpg",
  "genre_simulation", "genre_strategy"
)
primary_coefficients <- threshold_coefficients[
  threshold_coefficients$specification_id == "PRIMARY",
]
threshold_focus <- threshold_coefficients[threshold_coefficients$term %in% focus_terms,]
release_month_rows <- release_coefficients[grepl("^release_month", release_coefficients$term),]
release_shared <- release_comparison[
  !is.na(release_comparison$primary_odds_ratio) & release_comparison$term != "(Intercept)",
]
price_shared <- price_comparison[
  !is.na(price_comparison$primary_odds_ratio) & price_comparison$term != "(Intercept)",
]
genre_display <- genre_comparison[
  genre_comparison$term %in% c(
    "genre_action", "genre_adventure", "genre_casual", "genre_indie",
    "genre_rpg", "genre_simulation", "genre_strategy",
    "genre_early_access", "genre_sports", "genre_racing"
  ),
]
price_stability <- stability[stability$conceptual_term == "z_log1p_price",]
days_stability <- stability[stability$conceptual_term == "z_days_since_release",]
indie_stability <- stability[stability$conceptual_term == "genre_indie",]
rpg_stability <- stability[stability$conceptual_term == "genre_rpg",]
simulation_stability <- stability[stability$conceptual_term == "genre_simulation",]
strategy_stability <- stability[stability$conceptual_term == "genre_strategy",]
platform_stability <- stability[grepl("^platform_segment", stability$conceptual_term),]

stopifnot(
  nrow(diagnostics) == 7,
  all(diagnostics$converged),
  all(diagnostics$positive_definite_hessian),
  all(diagnostics$warning_count == 0),
  identical(threshold_samples$n_games, c(2206L, 1127L, 836L, 548L)),
  nrow(primary_coefficients) == 13
)
```

# Step 5D 分析目的

本报告审计冻结的主模型结论是否依赖四类预先指定的分析选择：评论数量阈值、发布时间表示、
价格变量变换和 Genre 集合。每个敏感性分析（sensitivity analysis）一次只改变一个规格，
其余设置均保持主规格不变。审计重点是方向、比值比（Odds Ratio, OR）幅度、
95% 置信区间（95% CI）及跨规格稳健性（robustness），不进行自动模型选择，也不作因果解释。

# 主模型规格回顾

主规格仍为 836 个评论数不少于 20 的付费游戏；响应变量是每个游戏的正面/负面评论分组计数，
平台 reference level 为 Windows only，价格与上市天数继续使用冻结的标准化参数，Genre 使用
Action、Adventure、Casual、Indie、RPG、Simulation 和 Strategy 七个指标。主规格的
Beta-binomial precision phi 为
`r sprintf("%.4f", diagnostics$beta_precision_phi[diagnostics$specification_id == "PRIMARY"])`，
组内相关 rho 为
`r sprintf("%.4f", diagnostics$intra_game_rho[diagnostics$specification_id == "PRIMARY"])`。

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    primary_coefficients[, c(
    "term", "estimate_log_odds", "std_error", "odds_ratio",
    "or_ci95_lower", "or_ci95_upper", "ci_crosses_1"
    )],
    term = term_zh(term),
    ci_crosses_1 = yes_no_zh(ci_crosses_1)
  ),
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c("预测变量", "log odds", "标准误", "OR", "95% CI 下限", "95% CI 上限", "CI 是否跨 1"),
  caption = "表：主模型 OR 与 95% CI"
)
```

# 评论数量阈值敏感性分析

主规格采用 `total_reviews >= 20`。其余 `>0`、`>=10` 和 `>=50`
仅作为预先指定的敏感性分析，不代表任何阈值“更优”。四个模型样本依次包含
2,206 / 1,127 / 836 / 548 个游戏，严格嵌套且均为付费游戏。`>0` 来源样本原有
2,207 个游戏，其中 1 个仅有两条评论的游戏缺少冻结价格变量，已明确记录为排除项；
所有阈值均沿用主规格的标准化参数。

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    threshold_samples[, c(
    "threshold", "source_paid_games", "excluded_missing_predictors", "n_games",
    "positive_reviews", "negative_reviews", "total_reviews",
    "pooled_positive_rate", "median_game_positive_rate",
    "price_mean_usd", "days_mean"
    )],
    pooled_positive_rate = 100 * pooled_positive_rate,
    median_game_positive_rate = 100 * median_game_positive_rate
  ),
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c(
    "评论阈值", "来源游戏数", "缺失预测变量排除数", "模型 N",
    "正面评论", "负面评论", "总评论", "汇总正面率（%）",
    "游戏层面正面率中位数（%）", "平均价格（美元）", "平均上市天数"
  ),
  caption = "表：评论阈值样本规模"
)
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    threshold_fit[, c(
    "specification_id", "n_games", "log_likelihood", "aic", "bic",
    "beta_precision_phi", "intra_game_rho", "converged",
    "positive_definite_hessian", "max_abs_fixed_gradient", "warning_count"
    )],
    specification_id = spec_zh(specification_id),
    converged = yes_no_zh(converged),
    positive_definite_hessian = yes_no_zh(positive_definite_hessian)
  ),
  digits = 5,
  col.names = c(
    "模型规格", "N", "logLik", "AIC", "BIC", "phi", "rho",
    "收敛", "Hessian 为正定", "最大绝对梯度", "警告数"
  ),
  caption = "表：不同评论阈值模型诊断（样本不同，不据 AIC 排序）"
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "评论数量阈值下的 Beta-binomial OR 与 Wald 95% CI"
knitr::include_graphics(figure_5d("09_threshold_or_comparison.png"))
```

> **人工审计重点**
>
> - 是否存在预测变量方向反转？
> - 是否有某一个评论阈值明显偏离其他规格？
> - 哪些 95% CI 从不跨 1 变为跨 1，或反向变化？

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    threshold_focus[, c(
    "threshold", "term", "odds_ratio", "or_ci95_lower", "or_ci95_upper",
    "ci_crosses_1"
    )],
    term = term_zh(term),
    ci_crosses_1 = yes_no_zh(ci_crosses_1)
  ),
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c("评论阈值", "预测变量", "OR", "95% CI 下限", "95% CI 上限", "CI 是否跨 1"),
  caption = "表：不同评论阈值下九个重点预测变量的 OR"
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "四个嵌套评论阈值下的 OR 点估计漂移"
knitr::include_graphics(figure_5d("10_threshold_coefficient_drift.png"))
```

> **人工审计重点**
>
> - OR 是否随阈值收紧而呈单调变化？
> - 即使方向未反转，OR 幅度是否变化到足以影响实质解释？

# 发布时间规格敏感性分析

主规格使用标准化的 `days_since_release`，替代规格使用分类变量 `release_month`，
并以 2025 年 7 月为 reference level。两者高度相关，因此不会同时进入同一个模型。
替代规格 AIC 为 `r sprintf("%.3f", release_fit$aic)`，主规格为
`r sprintf("%.3f", diagnostics$aic[diagnostics$specification_id == "PRIMARY"])`。
两者使用相同样本，允许谨慎比较 AIC，但该比较不会自动改变冻结的主规格。

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    release_shared[, c(
    "term", "primary_odds_ratio", "odds_ratio", "or_ci95_lower", "or_ci95_upper",
    "or_difference_pct", "direction_change", "ci_crosses_1_change"
    )],
    term = term_zh(term),
    direction_change = yes_no_zh(direction_change),
    ci_crosses_1_change = yes_no_zh(ci_crosses_1_change)
  ),
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c(
    "预测变量", "主规格 OR", "替代规格 OR", "95% CI 下限", "95% CI 上限",
    "OR 变化（%）", "方向变化", "CI 跨 1 状态变化"
  ),
  caption = "表：发布时间规格敏感性"
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "发布月份替代上市天数后，共同预测变量的 OR 对比"
knitr::include_graphics(figure_5d("11_release_specification_comparison.png"))
```

> **人工审计重点**
>
> - 替换时间变量后，Price、Platform、Simulation、Strategy、Indie 和 RPG 是否稳定？
> - 共同预测变量的 95% CI 与 OR=1 的关系是否变化？

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    release_month_rows[, c(
    "term", "estimate_log_odds", "std_error", "odds_ratio",
    "or_ci95_lower", "or_ci95_upper", "ci_crosses_1", "ci_method"

    ci_crosses_1 = yes_no_zh(ci_crosses_1)
  ),

```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "各发布月份相对 2025 年 7 月的 OR 与 95% CI"
knitr::include_graphics(figure_5d("12_release_month_effects.png"))
```

> **人工审计重点**
>
> - 是否有任一月份与 2025 年 7 月明显分离？
> - 月份估计的区间宽度是否显示较大的不确定性？

各月份 95% CI 均跨 1；`days_since_release` 在不同规格中的关联也较弱。
因此发布时间主要作为时间暴露或队列控制变量，而不是主要研究发现。

# 价格规格敏感性分析

主规格使用标准化的 `log1p(current_price_usd)`，替代规格使用标准化的原始
`current_price_usd`。两种 OR 都按对应变量增加 1 个标准差解释，不能直接理解为价格每增加 1 美元。
原始美元尺度与 log1p 尺度代表不同的价格变化，因此重点比较方向、幅度及其他系数的稳定性。

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    price_predictions[, c(
      "specification_id", "price_scale", "baseline_probability",
      "plus_1sd_probability", "absolute_probability_contrast"
    )],
    specification_id = spec_zh(specification_id)
  ),
  digits = 5,
  col.names = c(
    "模型规格", "价格对比尺度", "基准预测概率",
    "+1 SD 预测概率", "预测概率绝对变化"
  ),
  caption = "表：价格变量增加 1 SD 的预测概率对比"
)
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    price_shared[, c(
    "comparison_term", "primary_odds_ratio", "odds_ratio", "or_ci95_lower",
    "or_ci95_upper", "or_difference_pct", "direction_change", "ci_crosses_1_change"
    )],
    comparison_term = term_zh(comparison_term),
    direction_change = yes_no_zh(direction_change),
    ci_crosses_1_change = yes_no_zh(ci_crosses_1_change)
  ),
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c(
    "预测变量", "主规格 OR", "替代规格 OR", "95% CI 下限", "95% CI 上限",
    "OR 变化（%）", "方向变化", "CI 跨 1 状态变化"
  ),
  caption = "表：价格规格敏感性"
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "标准化 log1p 价格与标准化原始价格规格的 OR 对比"
knitr::include_graphics(figure_5d("13_price_specification_comparison.png"))
```

> **人工审计重点**
>
> - 更换价格变换后，Price 的方向或 CI 结论是否变化？
> - 其他预测变量的漂移是否大于 Price 本身的变化？

Price 在全部 7 个相关规格中均保持负方向，总体 OR 范围为
`r sprintf("%.3f", price_stability$minimum_or)`–`r sprintf("%.3f", price_stability$maximum_or)`，
最大 OR 漂移为 `r sprintf("%.2f", price_stability$max_or_drift_pct)`%。关联幅度较小但稳定。
需要注意，当前价格是采集时点美国 Steam storefront 的快照价格，不是 launch price，
也不是评论者实际支付的价格。

# Genre 规格敏感性分析

主模型 Genre 为 Action、Adventure、Casual、Indie、RPG、Simulation 和 Strategy；
扩展规格仅额外加入 Early Access、Sports 和 Racing。此处 Early Access 是冻结数据中的
Steam genre/category 标签，不代表历史 Early Access 状态或发行时状态。Sports 与 Racing
样本较稀疏，因此应优先审计 CI 宽度及其对原七个 Genre 系数的影响，不应仅依据单个 p 值作结论。

```{r}
original_genre_display <- genre_display[
  genre_display$term %in% c(
    "genre_action", "genre_adventure", "genre_casual", "genre_indie",
    "genre_rpg", "genre_simulation", "genre_strategy"
  ),
]
added_genre_display <- genre_display[
  genre_display$term %in% c("genre_early_access", "genre_sports", "genre_racing"),
]
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    original_genre_display[, c(
      "term", "primary_odds_ratio", "odds_ratio", "or_ci95_lower",
      "or_ci95_upper", "or_difference_pct", "direction_change"
    )],
    term = term_zh(term),
    direction_change = yes_no_zh(direction_change)
  ),
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c(
    "Genre", "主规格 OR", "扩展规格 OR", "95% CI 下限",
    "95% CI 上限", "OR 变化（%）", "方向变化"
  ),
  caption = "表：原七个 Genre 在集合扩展后的稳定性"
)
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    added_genre_display[, c(
      "term", "n_games_with_genre", "positive_reviews_with_genre",
      "negative_reviews_with_genre", "odds_ratio", "or_ci95_lower",
      "or_ci95_upper", "ci_crosses_1"
    )],
    term = term_zh(term),
    ci_crosses_1 = yes_no_zh(ci_crosses_1)
  ),
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c(
    "新增 Genre", "游戏数", "正面评论", "负面评论",
    "OR", "95% CI 下限", "95% CI 上限", "CI 是否跨 1"
  ),
  caption = "表：新增 Genre 指标审计"
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "主规格七个 Genre 与扩展后十个 Genre 的 OR 对比"
```

> **人工审计重点**
>
> - 原七个 Genre 的 OR 是否在扩展后出现明显漂移？
> - Sports 与 Racing 的 CI 是否过宽，因而不足以支持精确的方向判断？

# 各预测变量稳健性汇总

描述性分类规则保持不变：ROBUST（稳健）表示方向不变且最大 OR 漂移不超过 10%；
PARTIAL（部分稳健、存在一定规格敏感性）表示方向不变且漂移大于 10% 但不超过 25%；
SENSITIVE（对规格敏感）表示方向反转或漂移超过 25%。这些仅是人工审计规则，不是统计检验。

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    stability[, c(
      "conceptual_term", "specifications_available", "minimum_or", "primary_or",
      "maximum_or", "same_direction_specs", "ci_excluding_1_specs",
      "ci_crossing_1_specs", "max_or_drift_pct", "robustness_class"
    )],
    conceptual_term = term_zh(conceptual_term),
    robustness_class = unname(class_labels_zh[robustness_class])
  ),
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c(
    "预测变量", "可用规格数", "最小 OR", "主规格 OR", "最大 OR",
    "同方向规格数", "CI 不跨 1", "CI 跨 1", "最大漂移（%）", "稳健性分类"
  ),
  caption = "表：核心预测变量总体稳健性"
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "各重点预测变量的观测 OR 范围与冻结主规格估计值"
knitr::include_graphics(figure_5d("16_or_range_summary.png"))
```

> **人工审计重点**
>
> - 较窄的 OR 范围是否掩盖了多个跨 1 的 CI？
> - 哪个 Platform contrast 在方向不变时出现了最大的幅度漂移？

# Simulation（模拟类）深入审计

Step 5C Beta-binomial 主规格的 Simulation OR 为
`r sprintf("%.3f", simulation_stability$primary_or)`。Step 5D 各规格范围为
`r sprintf("%.3f", simulation_stability$minimum_or)`–`r sprintf("%.3f", simulation_stability$maximum_or)`，
7/7 个规格均保持负方向，且 7/7 个 CI 均不跨 1。Simulation 是当前最稳定的 Genre
关联之一，但这一结果仍是条件关联，不应解释为因果关系。

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Simulation 在全部预先指定规格下的 OR 与 Wald 95% CI"
knitr::include_graphics(figure_5d("17_simulation_sensitivity.png"))
```

> **人工审计重点**
>
> - Simulation 是否在全部规格中保持 OR < 1？
> - 评论数 > 0 的估计是否是孤立偏离，还是与其他规格形成连续变化？

# Price 深入审计

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Price 在全部预先指定规格下的 OR 与 Wald 95% CI"
knitr::include_graphics(figure_5d("18_price_sensitivity.png"))
```

> **人工审计重点**
>
> - Price 是否在每个相关模型中保持负方向？
> - 哪些规格的 CI 扩大到跨越 OR=1？

# Platform（平台）深入审计

三个 Platform contrast 在全部 7 个规格中均保持正方向，但 OR 幅度随评论数量阈值出现一定变化，
因此应描述为“方向稳定、幅度部分敏感”，而不是笼统称为 Platform 稳健。所有解释均相对于
Windows only。

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    platform_stability[, c(
      "conceptual_term", "minimum_or", "primary_or", "maximum_or",
      "same_direction_specs", "ci_excluding_1_specs", "max_or_drift_pct",
      "robustness_class"
    )],
    conceptual_term = term_zh(conceptual_term),
    robustness_class = unname(class_labels_zh[robustness_class])
  ),
  digits = 4,
  col.names = c(
    "Platform contrast", "最小 OR", "主规格 OR", "最大 OR",
    "同方向规格数", "CI 不跨 1", "最大漂移（%）", "稳健性分类"
  ),
  caption = "表：Platform 稳健性汇总"
)
```

# 模型诊断

只有 convergence code 为 0 且 Hessian 为正定的模型才可解释系数。以下表格同时展示最大梯度、
优化器信息、phi、rho、边界检查、样本一致性及 AIC 可比范围。7 个模型全部满足收敛要求；
最大绝对梯度为 `r sprintf("%.6f", max(diagnostics$max_abs_fixed_gradient))`，
捕获到的模型拟合警告数为 `r sum(diagnostics$warning_count)`。

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    diagnostics[, c(
    "specification_id", "n_games", "convergence_code", "converged",
    "positive_definite_hessian", "max_abs_fixed_gradient", "optimizer_message",
    "warning_count", "beta_precision_phi", "intra_game_rho",
    "dispersion_boundary_flag", "extreme_fixed_estimate_or_se_count",
    "same_rows_as_primary", "aic_comparable_to_primary", "delta_aic_vs_primary"
    )],
    specification_id = spec_zh(specification_id),
    converged = yes_no_zh(converged),
    positive_definite_hessian = yes_no_zh(positive_definite_hessian),
    dispersion_boundary_flag = yes_no_zh(dispersion_boundary_flag),
    same_rows_as_primary = yes_no_zh(same_rows_as_primary),
    aic_comparable_to_primary = yes_no_zh(aic_comparable_to_primary)
  ),
  digits = 5,
  col.names = c(
    "模型规格", "N", "收敛代码", "收敛", "Hessian 为正定", "最大绝对梯度",
    "优化器信息", "警告数", "phi", "rho", "离散参数边界标记",
    "极端估计/标准误数", "与主规格同样本", "AIC 可比", "相对主规格 ΔAIC"
  ),
  caption = "表：各 Beta-binomial 模型诊断结果"
)
knitr::kable(
  transform(
    fit_warnings,
    specification_id = spec_zh(specification_id),
    status = ifelse(status == "NO WARNING", "无警告", status)
  ),
  col.names = c("模型规格", "状态", "警告数", "警告内容"),
  caption = "表：模型拟合警告记录"
)
```

# 人工审计清单

- 确认 7 个模型均通过收敛、Hessian 与警告检查后再解释系数。
- 将评论阈值变化视为总体选择敏感性，不进行跨样本 AIC 竞赛。
- 确认发布月份替代而不是补充上市天数，两者未同时进入模型。
- 原始价格与 log1p 价格只能按各自增加 1 SD 的对比解释。
- 将 Early Access 视为 Steam genre/category 标签，并重点检查稀疏的 Sports、Racing CI。
- 先审计方向和幅度，再看 CI crossing 状态，最后才看 p 值。
- 检查结论是否仅依赖单一规格；不得由本报告自动修改冻结主模型。

# 阶段性结论

- **Price：ROBUST（稳健）**。7/7 个规格保持负方向，OR 范围
  `r sprintf("%.3f", price_stability$minimum_or)`–`r sprintf("%.3f", price_stability$maximum_or)`。
- **Platforms：PARTIAL（部分稳健）**。三个 contrast 均保持正方向，但幅度对评论阈值存在一定敏感性。
- **Indie：ROBUST（稳健）**。7/7 个规格保持正方向，最大 OR 漂移
  `r sprintf("%.2f", indie_stability$max_or_drift_pct)`%。
- **RPG：ROBUST（方向与幅度稳健）**。OR 范围
  `r sprintf("%.3f", rpg_stability$minimum_or)`–`r sprintf("%.3f", rpg_stability$maximum_or)`，
  但全部 7 个规格的 CI 均跨 1；这里的“稳健”不代表强统计证据。
- **Simulation：ROBUST（稳健）**。7/7 个规格保持负方向，OR 范围
  `r sprintf("%.3f", simulation_stability$minimum_or)`–`r sprintf("%.3f", simulation_stability$maximum_or)`。
- **Strategy：PARTIAL（部分稳健）**。方向保持为负，但最大 OR 漂移
  `r sprintf("%.2f", strategy_stability$max_or_drift_pct)`%。
- **发布时间**不作为 headline result：上市天数关联较弱，发布月份替代规格的各月份 CI 均跨 1。

方向稳定可以与 CI 跨 1 同时存在，PARTIAL 也可以与方向完全一致同时存在。
冻结的主规格继续作为审计基准；本报告不作因果推断、不自动修改模型，也不启动后续建模阶段。
